sentences.text:
While determining the income, an
 addition of 50 per cent of actual salary to
 the income of the deceased towards
 future prospects, where the deceased
 had a permanent job and was below the
 age of 40 years, should be made.

The
 addition should be 30 per cent, if the age
 of the deceased was between 40 and 50
 years.

In case the deceased was between
 22 Scch-17 Mvc 7423/2018 & 7424/2018
 the age of 50 and 60 years, the addition
 should be 15 per cent.

Actual salary
 should be read as actual salary less tax.

In case the deceased was self-
 employed or on a fixed salary, an
